terms.definitionEn: A structure for presenting data arranged in rows and columns.
terms.definitionAr: تركيب لعرض بيانات منظمة في صفوف وأعمدة.

terms.definitionEn: An element representing one row within a table.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيمثل صف واحد داخل الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: A data cell containing one value in a table row.
terms.definitionAr: خلية بيانات فيها قيمة واحدة داخل صف الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: Cell used to name a row or column of related table values.
terms.definitionAr: خلية بتسمي صف أو عمود من القيم المرتبطة في الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: An element providing a title or brief description for a table.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيضيف عنوان أو وصف قصير للجدول.

terms.definitionEn: A section grouping the header rows of a table.
terms.definitionAr: قسم بيجمع صفوف العناوين في الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: A section grouping the primary data rows of a table.
terms.definitionAr: قسم بيجمع صفوف البيانات الأساسية في الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: A section grouping summary rows at the end of a table.
terms.definitionAr: قسم بيجمع صفوف الملخص في نهاية الجدول.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute identifying the row or column direction covered by a header cell.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد إذا كان العنوان بيوصف صف أو عمود.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute making one table cell span multiple columns.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتخلي خلية واحدة تمتد على أكتر من عمود.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute making one table cell span multiple rows.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتخلي خلية واحدة تمتد على أكتر من صف.

terms.definitionEn: A cell that identifies the meaning of related data in a row or column.
terms.definitionAr: خلية بتوضح معنى البيانات المرتبطة في صف أو عمود.

questions.question: What kind of information is this structure intended to present?
options: Data arranged in related rows and columns
A sequence of unrelated page headings
A form whose controls submit automatically
A group of images with captions
questions.explanation: A table is intended for data with meaningful row and column relationships.
questions.explanationAr: الجدول مناسب لبيانات بينها علاقة واضحة بين الصفوف والأعمدة.

questions.question: What role does td have in this row?
options: A title above the table
A regular data cell
A page-level heading
A group of footer rows
questions.explanation: td represents a regular data cell; th represents a header cell.
questions.explanationAr: td بيمثل خلية بيانات عادية، أما th فبيمثل خلية عنوان.

questions.explanation: The caption and cell contents are visible; the caption precedes the row content.
questions.explanationAr: التعليق ومحتوى الخلايا ظاهرين، والتعليق بييجي قبل بيانات الصف.

questions.prompt: Create one table row containing a data cell.
questions.explanation: tr groups the cells that belong to one table row.

questions.question: Why use th for the Price cell?
options: It marks a data header
It adds a second column without another cell
It moves the value into the table caption
It makes the cell editable by the visitor
questions.explanation: th marks a header cell that gives meaning to related data cells.
questions.explanationAr: th بيحدد خلية عنوان بتوضح معنى خلايا البيانات المرتبطة.

questions.prompt: Mark April as a regular table data value.
questions.explanation: td is the element for a data cell.

questions.question: What information does caption add to this table?
options: A hidden value submitted with a form
A row header for every data cell
A replacement for the table element
A table's short title
questions.explanation: caption gives a table a concise title or description.
questions.explanationAr: caption بيدي الجدول عنوانًا أو وصفًا مختصرًا.

questions.explanation: Each cell's text appears in its corresponding table row.
questions.explanationAr: نص كل خلية بيظهر في الصف الخاص بيها.

questions.prompt: Group the main data rows separately from a table's heading and summary rows.
questions.explanation: tbody groups the primary data rows in a table.

questions.question: Which section is intended to group the table's summary row?
options: thead, which only holds the column titles
tfoot, which can contain summary rows
tbody, which groups all document metadata
caption, which replaces every row
questions.explanation: tfoot groups summary or footer rows; thead and tbody have different structural roles.
questions.explanationAr: tfoot بيجمع صفوف الملخص، ولكل من thead وtbody دور مختلف.

questions.prompt: Group the column-heading row in the table header section.
questions.explanation: thead groups rows that form the table's header.

options:
Queue

questions.explanation: The table caption and both cell values appear as readable text.
questions.explanationAr: تعليق الجدول وقيمتا الخليتين بيظهروا كنص مقروء.

questions.question: What does scope="row" communicate about this header?
options: It makes the header cover every column in the table
It merges the cell with the next row
It hides the header from assistive technology
It labels the row associated with the header cell
questions.explanation: scope="row" identifies a header as applying across its row.
questions.explanationAr: scope="row" بيوضح إن العنوان مرتبط بالصف.

questions.prompt: Indicate that the heading names the values beneath its column.
questions.explanation: scope="col" associates a header with the column's data cells.
The header and two body rows contribute text in their document order.
questions.explanationAr: العنوان وصفا البيانات بيظهروا بترتيب المستند.

questions.prompt: Make the total cell cover two adjacent columns.
questions.explanation: colspan makes a cell occupy multiple columns.

questions.question: What does rowspan="2" specify for the Studio cell?
options: The cell occupies two table rows
The cell contains exactly two lines of text
The table has two header rows
The cell spans two columns
questions.explanation: rowspan makes a cell extend across the specified number of rows.
questions.explanationAr: rowspan بيخلي الخلية تمتد عبر عدد الصفوف المحدد.

questions.prompt: Make this label cell cover two table rows.
questions.explanation: rowspan controls how many rows a cell occupies.

questions.question: What relationship does the row header express here?
options: header, since it is first in document order
The value 8 books describes Mira's row
The cell is only a visual caption
The row cannot contain a data cell
questions.explanation: A row-scoped header identifies the subject of data cells in that row.
questions.explanationAr: عنوان الصف بيوضح موضوع خلايا البيانات الموجودة في نفس الصف.

questions.prompt: Use a cell spanning two columns while keeping the summary readable.
questions.explanation: The span value determines how many columns the cell occupies.

questions.question: How do thead, tbody, and tfoot help organize a data table?
keyPoints: tbody groups the main data rows
These sections do not replace tr or cell elements
questions.modelAnswer: thead, tbody, and tfoot group different kinds of table rows. Rows and cells still use tr with th or td, while the sections make the table structure clearer.

questions.question: How do th and scope help people understand relationships in a table?
keyPoints: scope can identify a row or column header
questions.modelAnswer: th identifies a cell as a header rather than ordinary data. A suitable scope value clarifies whether it labels a row or column, helping users and assistive technologies connect the heading to its data.

questions.question: What is the difference between colspan and rowspan?
keyPoints: Both affect a cell's position in the table grid
Keep the resulting table structure coherent
questions.modelAnswer: colspan makes a cell cover more than one column, while rowspan makes it cover more than one row. The surrounding rows must still form a coherent table grid.

questions.question: When is a caption useful, and where does it belong?
keyPoints: It gives the table a concise title or description
It belongs inside the table element
It helps users identify the table's subject
It is distinct from a row or column header
questions.modelAnswer: A caption provides a short title or description that helps users identify a table's subject. It belongs inside the table and serves a different purpose from headers for individual rows or columns.
